# h3_k8s_cluster (Data Source)

Reads a managed Kubernetes cluster by ID. Use `h3_k8s_kubeconfig` for credentials. Uses API-key (HMAC) access to h3k8s (`api.h3llo.cloud/api/k8s/v3`): the key must list the project; scope `k8s:read` is enough to read, changes and the kubeconfig (admin credentials) need `k8s:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "h3_k8s_cluster" "main" {
  project_id = var.project_id
  id         = var.cluster_id
}

output "k8s_version" {
  value = data.h3_k8s_cluster.main.kubernetes_version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Cluster ID

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) Project ID (UUID); the provider default when omitted

### Read-Only

- `api_allowed_cidrs` (Set of String) Source CIDRs allowed to reach the Kubernetes API; empty = open to everyone
- `autoscaler_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the autoscaler is enabled
- `cluster_type` (String) `DEV` or `PROD`
- `control_plane_replicas` (Number) Control plane replicas
- `kubernetes_version` (String) Kubernetes version
- `name` (String) Cluster name
- `namespace` (String) Platform namespace of the cluster
- `network_id` (String) h3ovn network ID of the workers when `network_mode` is `vpc`
- `network_mode` (String) Worker network: `vpc` (a network of the project VPC) or `shared` (shared platform network); null on platforms without workers in the tenant VPC
- `node_local_dns_cache` (Boolean) Whether NodeLocal DNSCache is enabled (`false` on platforms without the feature)
- `node_local_dns_cache_state` (String) NodeLocal DNSCache state: `DISABLED`, `ENABLING`, `READY`, `DISABLING` or `ERROR`; null on platforms without the feature
- `pod_cidr` (String) Pod CIDR
- `service_cidr` (String) Service CIDR
- `status` (String) Cluster status
- `worker_cpu` (Number) vCPU per worker
- `worker_disk_gi` (Number) Disk per worker, GiB
- `worker_memory_gi` (Number) Memory per worker, GiB
- `worker_replicas` (Number) Current worker count
